name: Monsters of Little Haven
source:
The main focus in "Monsters of Little Haven" interactive novel is a story of Little Haven village. At the heart of the action are a twelve-year-old Kenneth and his younger sister Esme, children of the Murphy family, who hit the trail of a mysterious monster following series of entangled events

The nonlinearity of the story allows you to learn a variety of secrets surrounding the Murphy family. The main goal is to find the approach to all of them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《小港怪物》互动小说的主要内容是小港村的故事。故事的核心人物是墨菲家族的孩子们，十二岁的肯尼思和他的妹妹埃斯梅，在经历一系列错综复杂的事件后，他们追踪到了一个神秘怪物的踪迹。

故事的非线性让你了解墨菲家族的各种秘密。主要目标是找到解决所有这些问题的方法。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101930/]Steam[/url]]
